name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students

chunks.overview: Post Matric Scholarship for SC students supports Scheduled Caste students studying at post-matriculation level, covering maintenance allowance and course fees.
chunks.elig: Eligibility: the applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste. Annual family income from all sources must not exceed Rs 2,50,000. The course must be at the post-matriculation level, including diploma, degree and postgraduate programmes.
chunks.docs: Documents required: Aadhaar number, caste certificate, income certificate, previous year marksheet, bank passbook copy, institute admission or fee receipt.
chunks.benefit: Benefits: maintenance allowance per month depending on course group, plus reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees.
chunks.apply: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal. Application windows differ every year, so check the portal for the current deadline.

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students

chunks.overview: The Central Sector Scheme rewards meritorious students from low-income families who pursue regular undergraduate or postgraduate courses.
chunks.elig: Eligibility: parental income must not exceed Rs 4,50,000 per year. The student must have scored at least 80% in the qualifying examination (a simplification of the top-percentile rule used for this demo). The student must be in an undergraduate or postgraduate course. The student must not be receiving any other scholarship.
chunks.docs: Documents required: Aadhaar number, class 12 marksheet, income certificate, bank account details, college bonafide certificate.
chunks.benefit: Benefits: annual scholarship amount paid for each year of the course, renewed on satisfactory academic performance.
chunks.apply: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal. Application windows differ every year, so check the portal for the current deadline.

name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojana

chunks.overview: This Maharashtra scheme reimburses part of the tuition fees for economically weaker students from the open category in professional courses.
chunks.elig: Eligibility: the student must be a resident of Maharashtra and belong to the open category (including EWS). Family income must not exceed Rs 8,00,000 per year. The student must have at least 50% in the previous qualifying examination. The course must be a professional or degree programme.
chunks.docs: Documents required: domicile certificate, income certificate, previous marksheet, Aadhaar number, bank passbook copy, fee receipt.
chunks.benefit: Benefits: partial reimbursement of tuition and examination fees paid directly through the state portal.
chunks.apply: Apply online on the MahaDBT portal. Application windows differ every year, so check the portal for the current deadline.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls in Technical Education

chunks.overview: The Pragati scholarship encourages girls to take up AICTE approved technical degree and diploma programmes.
chunks.elig: Eligibility: the applicant must be a girl student admitted to an AICTE approved technical degree or diploma programme. Family income must not exceed Rs 8,00,000 per year. The student must not be receiving any other scholarship.
chunks.docs: Documents required: Aadhaar number, income certificate, admission letter, bank passbook copy, class 12 or diploma marksheet.
chunks.benefit: Benefits: yearly financial support towards tuition fees and incidentals for the duration of the course.
chunks.apply: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal. Application windows differ every year, so check the portal for the current deadline.

chunks.overview: The minorities scholarship helps students of notified minority communities continue studies at the post-matriculation level.
chunks.elig: Eligibility: the applicant must belong to a notified minority community. Annual family income must not exceed Rs 2,00,000. The student must have scored at least 50% in the previous examination. The course must be at the post-matriculation level. The student must not be receiving any other scholarship.
chunks.docs: Documents required: Aadhaar number, minority community declaration, income certificate, previous marksheet, bank passbook copy, fee receipt.
chunks.benefit: Benefits: admission and tuition fee support plus a maintenance allowance for eligible courses.
chunks.apply: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal. Application windows differ every year, so check the portal for the current deadline.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for ST Students

chunks.overview: Post Matric Scholarship for ST students supports Scheduled Tribe students studying at post-matriculation level with maintenance allowance and compulsory fees.
chunks.elig: Eligibility: the applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe. Annual family income from all sources must not exceed Rs 2,50,000. The course must be at the post-matriculation level, including diploma, degree and postgraduate programmes.
chunks.docs: Documents required: Aadhaar number, tribe certificate, income certificate, previous year marksheet, bank passbook copy, institute fee receipt.
chunks.benefit: Benefits: maintenance allowance per month depending on course group, plus reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees.
chunks.apply: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal. Application windows differ every year, so check the portal for the current deadline.

name: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Professional and Technical Courses (Minorities)

chunks.overview: The merit-cum-means scholarship helps students of notified minority communities who pursue professional and technical courses.
chunks.elig: Eligibility: the applicant must belong to a notified minority community. Family income must not exceed Rs 2,50,000 per year. The student must have at least 50% in the previous qualifying examination. The course must be a technical or professional programme.
chunks.docs: Documents required: Aadhaar number, minority community declaration, income certificate, previous marksheet, admission letter, bank passbook copy.
chunks.benefit: Benefits: course fee and maintenance allowance up to a fixed annual limit.
chunks.apply: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal. Application windows differ every year, so check the portal for the current deadline.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for OBC Students (Maharashtra)

chunks.overview: This Maharashtra scheme supports students of Other Backward Classes at post-matriculation level by reimbursing fees and giving maintenance support.
chunks.elig: Eligibility: the student must be a resident of Maharashtra and belong to the Other Backward Class. Family income must not exceed Rs 8,00,000 per year. The course must be at the post-matriculation level, including diploma, degree and postgraduate programmes.
chunks.docs: Documents required: domicile certificate, caste certificate, non-creamy layer certificate, income certificate, previous marksheet, bank passbook copy.
chunks.benefit: Benefits: reimbursement of eligible tuition and examination fees and a maintenance allowance.
chunks.apply: Apply online through the MahaDBT portal. Application windows differ every year, so check the portal for the current deadline.

chunks.overview: The Swami Vivekananda scholarship gives monthly financial support to meritorious students from low-income families in West Bengal.
chunks.elig: Eligibility: the student must be a resident of West Bengal. Family income must not exceed Rs 2,50,000 per year. The student must have at least 60% in the qualifying examination. The student must be in an undergraduate or postgraduate course.
chunks.docs: Documents required: domicile certificate, income certificate, class 12 marksheet, Aadhaar number, bank passbook copy, college bonafide certificate.
chunks.benefit: Benefits: monthly scholarship amount paid for the duration of the course.
chunks.apply: Apply online through the state scholarship portal. Application windows differ every year, so check the portal for the current deadline.

chunks.overview: MYSY supports meritorious students of Gujarat with tuition fee assistance for higher education.
chunks.elig: Eligibility: the student must be a resident of Gujarat. Family income must not exceed Rs 6,00,000 per year. The student must have scored at least 80% in the qualifying examination (a simplification of the percentile rule used for this demo). The student must be in an undergraduate or diploma course.
chunks.docs: Documents required: domicile certificate, income certificate, class 12 marksheet, Aadhaar number, bank passbook copy, admission letter.
chunks.benefit: Benefits: partial tuition fee assistance for approved courses.
chunks.apply: Apply online through the MYSY portal. Application windows differ every year, so check the portal for the current deadline.

chunks.overview: The Kotak Kanya Scholarship supports meritorious girls from low-income families who pursue professional undergraduate courses.
chunks.elig: Eligibility: the applicant must be a girl student. Family income must not exceed Rs 6,00,000 per year. The student must have scored at least 75% in class 12. The course must be a professional undergraduate programme such as engineering or medicine. The student must not be receiving any other scholarship.
chunks.docs: Documents required: Aadhaar number, class 12 marksheet, income certificate, admission letter, bank passbook copy.
chunks.benefit: Benefits: yearly financial support towards course expenses.
chunks.apply: Apply online through the foundation's online application page. Application windows differ every year, so check the portal for the current deadline.

chunks.overview: The LIC Golden Jubilee Scholarship helps meritorious students from low-income families continue undergraduate or diploma studies.
chunks.elig: Eligibility: family income must not exceed Rs 2,50,000 per year. The student must have at least 60% in class 12 or equivalent. The student must be in an undergraduate or diploma course. The student must not be receiving any other scholarship.
chunks.docs: Documents required: Aadhaar number, income certificate, class 12 marksheet, admission letter, bank passbook copy.
chunks.benefit: Benefits: yearly scholarship amount for the duration of the course.
chunks.apply: Apply online through the LIC scholarship application page. Application windows differ every year, so check the portal for the current deadline.

name: ONGC Foundation Scholarship for Professional Courses

chunks.overview: The ONGC Foundation scholarship supports meritorious students from low-income families in engineering, medicine and management programmes.
chunks.elig: Eligibility: family income must not exceed Rs 4,50,000 per year. The student must have at least 60% in the qualifying examination. The course must be a professional programme in engineering, medicine or management. The student must not be receiving any other scholarship.
chunks.docs: Documents required: Aadhaar number, income certificate, previous marksheet, admission letter, bank passbook copy.
chunks.benefit: Benefits: fixed yearly scholarship amount for the duration of the course.
chunks.apply: Apply online through the foundation's online application page. Application windows differ every year, so check the portal for the current deadline.

name: HDFC Parivartan Educational Crisis Scholarship Support

chunks.overview: The HDFC Parivartan scholarship supports students who face a financial crisis while studying at undergraduate, postgraduate or diploma level.
chunks.elig: Eligibility: family income must not exceed Rs 2,50,000 per year. The student must have at least 55% in the previous examination. The student must be in an undergraduate, postgraduate or diploma course.
chunks.docs: Documents required: Aadhaar number, income certificate, previous marksheet, admission fee receipt, bank passbook copy.
chunks.benefit: Benefits: one-time financial assistance towards education expenses.
chunks.apply: Apply online through the foundation's online application page. Application windows differ every year, so check the portal for the current deadline.
